title: Omnibus Token Position Reconciliation
description: Reconciles a declared tokenized-securities omnibus token position against the sum of declared registered-wallet balances and a declared custodian book-entry position: exact integer deltas per leg, an inclusive tolerance, a SHA-256 chained head over declared mint, burn, forced-transfer and transfer events, and a RECONCILED / MISMATCH / UNDECIDABLE verdict. An unregistered wallet holding a balance forces MISMATCH under the DTS profile. Arithmetic only: reads no ledger, proves no balance real.

profile.description: dtc_dts applies the registered-wallet rule from the pinned no-action letter (an unregistered wallet holding a balance forces MISMATCH); generic_omnibus omits that rule. Absent defaults to generic_omnibus, flagged; other values refused.

as_of.description: Caller-declared snapshot date label, YYYY-MM-DD. No clock is read; anything outside that shape is refused.

omnibus_balance.description: The omnibus token position in integer base units as a decimal string. Numbers, fractional, signed, or malformed values are refused, never coerced.

book_entry_position.description: The custodian's book-entry position for the same holding, integer base units as a decimal string, same refusal domain as omnibus_balance.

tolerance_units.description: Inclusive tolerance band in integer base units applied to both legs' absolute deltas; 0 when absent. Negative or fractional values are refused.

wallets.description: Per-wallet declared balances under opaque labels: wallet_label (opaque, unique; identifier-shaped labels refused as PII, never echoed), balance (decimal string; missing refused, never assumed zero), registered (boolean).

wallet_label.description: Opaque wallet handle, [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}, unique within the declaration.

balance.description: Wallet balance in integer base units as a decimal string.

registered.description: Whether the wallet is a registered wallet under the declared profile.

events.description: Declared event log entries chained in seq order: seq (unique non-negative integer), kind (mint, burn, forced_transfer, or transfer), amount (decimal string), wallet_label (same opaque-label domain).

kind.description: One of mint, burn, forced_transfer, transfer.

amount.description: Event amount in integer base units as a decimal string.

wallet_label.description: Opaque wallet handle the event concerns.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: profile, as_of, omnibus_balance, book_entry_position, tolerance_units, wallets, events. No required array: the kernel flags absent-but-well-formed legs (the receipt states what it could not reconcile) and refuses malformed values with structured refusal payloads, so every refusal branch stays reachable through every call path.
